signals.text: 2 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
Own the product roadmap: Define platform strategy, quarterly objectives, and priorities that centralize and standardize data capabilities across teams.
Apply product judgment: Identify underlying problems, test assumptions, and balance business value, effort, urgency, and dependencies. Make clear what the team will pursue and…
Define requirements and success: Translate business and analyst needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
Partner with technical leads: Agree on achievable commitments, navigate tradeoffs, and resolve blockers while leads own technical planning, execution, and validation.
Drive adoption and impact: Coordinate rollout, communication, and training; measure results and use feedback to improve future investments.
Own AI product strategy for investor workflows: Define how AI transforms the way public market investors consume, analyze, and act on data.
Build AI-native products, not just features: Design end-to-end experiences across agents, copilots, and structured outputs, not just UI layers on top of models.
Translate frontier AI into real-world utility: Evaluate and integrate LLMs, retrieval systems, and agent architectures into production-grade products.
Work directly with customers: Partner with hedge funds and asset managers to deeply understand workflows, pain points, and trust requirements.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration: Run tight feedback loops across prompts, evals, and product UX to continuously improve performance and usefulness.
Manage, coach, and grow a team of product managers, strengthening their customer discovery, strategic judgment, execution, and commercial ownership.
Establish clear product responsibilities, goals, and decision-making expectations, giving PMs the autonomy and support to own their products.
Build effective practices for planning, roadmap reviews, customer feedback, and performance measurement.
Recruit and develop talent as the team grows, while maintaining a high bar for product thinking and accountability.
